channel.title: Blockheight
channel.description: Blockheight reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Four Checks Before You Mark a Cross-Chain Transfer Complete
item.description: A cross-chain transfer is done only when the destination chain records the expected asset at the intended address; check the route, receipt, amount and fees.

item.title: How to Fund Recurring Costs on a Low-Fee Chain
item.description: Recurring crypto costs work best when payment funds and gas stay on the same low-fee chain, with automation limited to amounts and schedules you can verify.

item.title: Where a Rango bridge swap can stall
item.description: A pending Rango bridge swap can pause before source confirmation, during cross-chain delivery or at destination execution; each stage points to a different next step.

item.title: How to Set Slippage for a BNB Smart Chain Swap
item.description: Slippage tolerance sets the worst output a BNB Smart Chain swap will accept; choose it from the quote, liquidity and route, then check minimum received.

item.title: PooCoin volume bars reset at UTC day boundaries
item.description: A PooCoin daily volume bar totals trades in its candle window, while a rolling 24-hour figure moves with the clock; check the interval and time boundary before comparing them.

item.title: What to do when a bridge session expires before confirmation
item.description: A bridge page timing out does not prove a transfer failed; check the source transaction, route status and recovery conditions before retrying the transfer.

item.title: Bridge upgrades shift what crypto users must trust
item.description: Bridge upgrades can change the contracts, signers or proofs securing transfers; check the new trust assumptions and migration steps before moving funds.

item.title: Schedule Mantle withdrawals before payout deadlines
item.description: Mantle withdrawals need an L2 request, proof settlement and an Ethereum claim, so payout schedules should allow for processing, claim gas and network delays.

item.title: How treasury teams reconcile cross-chain transfers
item.description: Cross-chain reconciliation matches source debits to destination credits and separates delays, fees and failures before treasury balances are reported.

item.title: How Contract Wallet Deposits Work Across Bridges
item.description: Contract wallets can receive bridged tokens, but the destination address, account deployment and gas rules determine whether you can use them on the receiving chain.

item.title: Compare cross-chain swap costs before you send
item.description: A cross-chain swap quote combines network gas, route fees, liquidity and slippage; compare the same input and destination amount before approving a transfer.

item.title: Why cross-chain swaps cost more than a trading fee
item.description: Cross-chain swap costs combine network fees, liquidity pricing and service charges; learn what changes the final amount you receive before confirming.

item.title: Chainflip swap costs combine protocol, pool and network fees
item.description: Chainflip charges a 0.10% protocol fee plus pool and blockchain costs; the route, destination network and optional boost determine what a swap costs overall.

item.title: Solana DEX Tick Array Boundaries Shape Swap Execution
item.description: Solana tick arrays group pool ticks into accounts that swaps traverse in order; spacing and supplied arrays shape execution, price limits and route reliability.

item.title: How to Withdraw Part of a Concentrated Liquidity Position
item.description: A partial withdrawal removes a chosen share of a concentrated liquidity position, returning its current token mix while leaving the rest exposed to the pool.

item.title: How to Move Large Amounts Within Bridge Rate Limits
item.description: Large crypto transfers fit bridge rate limits when you check the route’s live cap, size each transfer within it and wait for capacity to refill before retrying.

item.title: Why refresh token metadata after a cross-chain transfer?
item.description: Refreshing token metadata after a bridge can correct a wallet’s symbol, decimals, logo or token listing, but it does not alter the asset or finish a transfer.

item.title: Blackhole LPs need gauge stakes to earn emissions
item.description: Blackhole pays $BLACK emissions only to liquidity staked in pool gauges; LPs should check pool votes, gauge eligibility and migration status before committing funds.

item.title: Token metadata gaps can mislabel assets and disrupt swaps
item.description: Token metadata gaps can hide or mislabel assets, distort displayed balances and complicate swap setup, while pool math still depends on contract addresses and raw token amounts.

item.title: How to Check Blackhole Swap Approvals Before Signing
item.description: Check the token, spender, network and allowance in a swap approval before signing; the requested amount helps show what a contract may be able to spend.
